met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining areas of north Odisha, & Jharkhand lies over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining Jharkhand at 1730 IST of today, the 01st September, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwest with height. It is likely to move west-northwestwards across Jharkhand and East Uttar Pradesh during next 48 hours.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Ferozpur, Ludhiana, Muzaffarnagar, Hardoi, Prayagraj, centre of Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining Jharkhand, Sagar Islands and thence southeastwards to Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The trough fromthe cyclonic circulation associated with Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining Jharkhand to northwest Uttar Pradesh across East Uttar Pradesh extending upto 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from south Gujarat to the cyclonic circulation associated with Well Marked Low Pressure Area over Gangetic West Bengal and adjoining Jharkhandacross Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh at 5.8 Km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan & adjoining Jammu Division at 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
